reason: Prevent git archive and checkout newline conversion from changing reviewed source texts, question-bank evidence and browser tests. Content and prior evidence remain unchanged.

.gitattributes.before_text:
# Preserve downloaded official HTML bytes so recorded source hashes stay valid.
docs/**/*.html -text
# Preserve source/review hashes across Windows and Linux checkouts.
revision/study-notes/** -text
revision/part6-sample/** -text
.gitattributes text eol=lf
.gitignore text eol=lf
.github/workflows/*.yml text eol=lf
web/*.html text eol=lf
web/*.js text eol=lf
web/*.css text eol=lf
web/fonts/*.txt text eol=lf
# These reviewed extracted texts have CRLF byte hashes in the study manifest.
docs/text/EN/15.txt -text
docs/text/TC/15.txt -text
